title: Character Viewing Sheets
description: Character Viewing Sheets — The Townstons wiki
html:
Character Sheet Viewers made by players. These viewers use the XML feed from the website of Dungeon Runners. With these viewers, you are able to see what a person wears, and what skills he has. Mind that sheets are saved every 15 minutes, so that the character sheets might not be accurate if the person switched some gear within those 15 minutes.
